title: Soaring Sora (Googifloop)
description: This mod adds Sora (From Yimmbin, formerly Googifloop) as a helpful, albeit deadly mob, along with other objects, tools, and related mobs!
body:
# Soaring Sora (RenJ's Different Silly Funky Googifloop Mod)

**Soaring Sora**, also known as _RenJ's Different Silly Funky Googifloop Mod_, adds new **mobs**, **items**, **weapons**, and **game mechanics** to your world!

![Sora alone, standing on a tree in a savanna village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad01f132a186980e00ab53304415fd606eae2bf6.png)
![The aftermath of a few The Suns](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6bd88609f4a221d259ff5cc3e67f60b31b56d8ea.png)

You can venture the world with Sora/Riku as a new companion, but just make sure not to aggravate them (it's sorta hard to do on accident)! Discover new helpful weapons and items, crafting recipes, and soon to be structures, biomes and dimensions!

## Entities
- **Sora**, a helpful yet dangerous flying entity that can aid you in combat
  - Can be befriended (tamed) and led with **light gray dye**
  - Can be led with a jukebox in hand
  - Flys around and attacks the last player-hit enemy when befriended
- **Riku**, another helpful land entity that aids you in combat, also dangerous
  - Can be befriended and led with **black dye**
  - Can be led with a jukebox in hand
  - Runs around and attacks the last player-hit enemy when befriended
- Both Riku and/or Sora will activate a _boss battle_ if provoked too much.
- By default, only one Sora/Riku can exist in the world at a time, but this can be adjusted!
- Both will attack monsters by default, but Sora can be told _not to_ once befriended!
- **The Stargazer**, a new villager profession who trades both useful vanilla items and new items for emeralds

## Jupiter: A new dimension!
- Reachable through an **orbital launcher**
- Biome entirely made of fluid gas (please bring elytra)
- Airships dotted throughout the Jovian clouds

![A Soracrop growing in a village farm plot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c1f51d4b5d89258016059627a3f6833d192d90d.png)

## Items
- **Soracrops**, which can produce items relating to both Sora and Riku
- **Sora pebbles**, the seeds for Soracrops dropped by Sora upon death :(
- **Rikubytes**, edible glitches that can teleport you three blocks forward in the direction you look in (be careful), dropped by Riku upon death :(
- **Protons**, **Neutrons**, and **Electrons** as basic atomic particles to craft things
- **Atoms**, **Gas**, and **Plasma** each made from the previous
  - Pure plasma _harms the player_ while holding
  - Can be crafted into **plasma orbs and beyond**



## Weapons
- **Plasma Orbs, Quark Orbs, and The Sun** as new powerful energy projectile weapons
  - Plasma Orbs take 20 exp per shot and release explosion on entity contact
  - Quark Orbs take 50 exp per shot and release explosions on any contact
  - The Sun takes 80 exp per shot and releases a massive ring of explosions, decimating everything (slightly overkill)
- **Sora's Star**, a powerful weapon that shortly makes entities levitate
- **Rikusword**, a powerful sword that applies a lot of damaging effects to entities hit
